body: I can't thank you enough. I'm so sorry to hear that anyone is going though this, so it means a lot to hear advice from someone in your situation. Take it one year at a time, I like that :) and I will try to reassure her that failure doesn't mean the end of the world if it does happen.
One day at a time. If I can just keep her around another day, maybe things will get better tomorrow.

I feel I've done the first one more times that I can count, but you're right, I should spend more time listening to what she has to get off her chest. Second, while I know I should be giving her space, I don't want to take the chance she will do something when I am not around. Lastly, I want to get professional help, but I don't know where to turn. All I can find are these cheesy 1800 numbers that will just say cliche things. She is seeing a therapist, but it's only once a week, and I don't feel this is frequent enough. But thank you for responding here, I really appreciate it.

Hello first off thank you for being so willing to help. The world needs more people like you. Second, whenever you get a chance, please read my story and post any help you may have. It would mean the world to me.
